blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — Police seized around P16 million worth of suspected shabu and arrested a high-value target in a buy-bust operation early Wednesday in Ipil, Zamboanga Sibugay. Lt. Joy Necesario, Zamboanga Sibugay Police Provincial Office information officer, said the suspect was a 32-year-old male resident of Barangay Tenan, Ipil. The operation was conducted at 3:20 a.m. on Nov. 11 at Purok San Francisco in Barangay Poblacion. It was led by the Ipil Municipal Police Station, alongside other local law enforcement units.
